subject.title: feat: MCP Apps (ui://) Phase 0 — generic host in Control UI + plugin-declared MCP servers

question: Should native plugin manifests permanently gain the new `mcpServers` field as an external plugin contract in this Phase 0 PR?
rationale: The field creates a public plugin API with activation, path-resolution, disabling, and user-override semantics; implementation alone cannot establish that permanent product contract.

options.title: Approve the manifest API
options.body: Keep `mcpServers`, retain documented user-config precedence and disable behavior, and treat the focused compatibility tests as the permanent contract.

options.title: Use existing configuration only
options.body: Remove the manifest field and initially ship MCP Apps through existing user `mcp.servers` configuration.

options.title: Split the API follow-up
options.body: Land the generic host after the CSP repair and review plugin-declared servers in a narrower follow-up PR.

recommendation.title: Approve the manifest API
recommendation.body: Keep `mcpServers`, retain documented user-config precedence and disable behavior, and treat the focused compatibility tests as the permanent contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the requested reviewer and strongest history-backed owner for this cross-cutting Control UI and plugin contract.
